data.title: Radiant Logistics, Waystar, Forgent Power Solutions And Other Big Stocks Moving Higher On Tuesday
data.description: U.S. stocks fell, but Radiant Logistics surged 17.8% after beating Q4 estimates. Waystar, Telix and Forgent also posted strong gains.

data.title: ExxonMobil Trending After Subsidiary Completes $2.1 Billion Debt Tender
data.description: Exxon Mobil is trending Tuesday. Its subsidiary announced the results of its cash tender offers for Pioneer Natural Resources notes.

data.title: TotalEnergies Bets Over $115 Million on AI to Hunt for Oil With Mistral
data.description: TotalEnergies partners with Mistral AI in a €100M initiative to transform oil exploration and reservoir engineering. TTE stock gains.

data.title: Dow Tumbles Over 250 Points; NY Empire State Manufacturing Index Falls In September
data.description: U.S. stocks fell Tuesday, led by a 250-point Dow drop, as weak manufacturing data pressured markets; energy rose while real estate declined.

data.title: Cathie Wood Backs AI Slowdown but Calls Extinction Fears ‘Ridiculous:’ What Do Prediction Markets Say?
